questions.question: Against which wealthy trading city is the oracle in Isaiah 23?
How is Tyre described before its fall?
options: A bestower of crowns whose merchants were princes
A holy city wholly set apart for the worship of God
A fortress of cut stone that no army could ever breach
A poor little village quite forgotten by all the nations
questions.answer: A bestower of crowns whose merchants were princes

questions.question: Isaiah 23 says Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years.
The oracle concerning _____. Wail, O ships of Tarshish!
Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, like the days of one _____.
